description_en: Creates a custom alert rule by calling CreateRemind
description_zh: 调用CreateRemind创建自定义报警规则
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public create-remind --remind-name test_error_remind --remind-unit NODE --remind-type FINISHED --alert-unit OWNER --alert-methods SMS,MAIL --api-version 2020-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateRemind

parameters.help_en: The name of the custom rule. The name can be up to 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 自定义规则的名称，不能超过128个字符
parameters.name: remind_name

parameters.help_en: The end time of the do-not-disturb period, in the hh:mm format. Valid values of hh: [0,23]. Valid values of mm: [0,59]
parameters.help_zh: 免打扰截止时间，格式为hh:mm。hh的取值范围为[0,23]，mm的取值范围为[0,59]。
parameters.name: dnd_end

parameters.help_en: The type of the object. Valid values: NODE (node), BASELINE (baseline), PROJECT (workspace), and BIZPROCESS (business process)
parameters.help_zh: 对象的类型，包括NODE（任务节点）、BASELINE（基线） 、PROJECT（工作空间）和BIZPROCESS（业务流程）
parameters.name: remind_unit

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the nodes to monitor when RemindUnit (object type) is set to NODE (node). Separate multiple IDs with commas (,). A maximum of 50 nodes can be monitored by a single rule
parameters.help_zh: RemindUnit（对象类型）为NODE（任务节点）时，监控的任务节点ID。多个ID之间使用英文逗号（,）分隔，一个规则最多监控50个节点
parameters.name: node_ids

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the baselines to monitor when RemindUnit (object type) is set to BASELINE (baseline). Separate multiple IDs with commas (,). A maximum of 5 baselines can be monitored by a single rule
parameters.help_zh: 当RemindUnit（对象类型）为BASELINE（基线）时，监控的基线ID。多个ID之间使用英文逗号（,）分隔，一个规则最多监控5条基线
parameters.name: baseline_ids

parameters.help_en: The ID of the workspace to monitor when RemindUnit (object type) is set to PROJECT (workspace). A single rule can monitor only one workspace
parameters.help_zh: 当RemindUnit（对象类型）为PROJECT（工作空间）时，监控的工作空间ID。一个规则只能监控一个工作空间
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the business processes to monitor when RemindUnit (object type) is set to BIZPROCESS (business process). Separate multiple business process IDs with commas (,). A maximum of 5 business processes can be monitored by a single rule
parameters.help_zh: 当RemindUnit（对象类型）为BIZPROCESS（业务流程）时，监控的业务流程ID。多个业务流程ID之间使用英文逗号（,）分隔，一个规则最多监控5个业务流程
parameters.name: biz_process_ids

parameters.help_en: The trigger condition. Valid values: FINISHED (completed), UNFINISHED (not completed), ERROR (error), CYCLE_UNFINISHED (cycle not completed), and TIMEOUT (running timeout)
parameters.help_zh: 触发条件，包括FINISHED（完成）、UNFINISHED（未完成）、ERROR（出错）、 CYCLE_UNFINISHED（周期未完成）和TIMEOUT（运行超时）
parameters.name: remind_type

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of alerts. Minimum value: 1. Maximum value: 10. Default value: 3
parameters.help_zh: 最大报警次数。最小值为1，最大值为10，默认值为3
parameters.name: max_alert_times

parameters.help_en: The minimum alert interval, in seconds. Minimum value: 1200. Default value: 1800
parameters.help_zh: 最小报警间隔，单位为秒。最小值为1200，默认值为1800
parameters.name: alert_interval

parameters.help_en:
The descriptions for different trigger conditions are as follows:

When RemindType (trigger condition) is set to FINISHED (completed), pass an empty value.

When RemindType (trigger condition) is set to UNFINISHED (not completed), pass parameter in the format of {"hour":23,"minu":59}. Valid values of hour: [0,47]. Valid values of minu: [0,59].

When RemindType (trigger condition) is set to ERROR (error), pass an empty value.

When RemindType (trigger condition) is set to CYCLE_UNFINISHED (cycle not completed), pass parameter in the format of {"1":"05:50","2":"06:50","3":"07:50","4":"08:50","5":"09:50","6":"10:50","7":"11:50","8":"12:50","9":"13:50","10":"14:50","11":"15:50","12":"16:50","13":"17:50","14":"18:50","15":"19:50","16":"20:50","17":"21:50","18":"22:50","19":"23:50","20":"24:50","21":"25:50"}. The key in the JSON character string is the cycle number. Valid values: [1,288]. The value is the not-completed time for the corresponding cycle, in the hh:mm format. Valid values of hh: [0,47]. Valid values of mm: [0,59].

When RemindType (trigger condition) is set to TIMEOUT (running timeout), pass parameter as a value such as 1800, in seconds. This means that an alert is triggered if the running time exceeds 30 minutes from the start of execution
parameters.help_zh:
不同触发条件的说明如下：

当RemindType（触发条件）为FINISHED（完成）时，传空。

当RemindType（触发条件）为UNFINISHED（未完成）时，传参格式为{"hour":23,"minu":59}。hour的取值范围为[0,47]，minu的取值范围为[0,59]。

当RemindType（触发条件）为ERROR（出错）时，传空。

当RemindType（触发条件）为CYCLE_UNFINISHED（周期未完成）时，传参格式为{"1":"05:50","2":"06:50","3":"07:50","4":"08:50","5":"09:50","6":"10:50","7":"11:50","8":"12:50","9":"13:50","10":"14:50","11":"15:50","12":"16:50","13":"17:50","14":"18:50","15":"19:50","16":"20:50","17":"21:50","18":"22:50","19":"23:50","20":"24:50","21":"25:50"}。JSON字符串key为周期号，取值范围为[1,288]。value为该周期对应的未完成时间，格式为hh:mm。hh的取值范围为[0,47]，mm的取值范围为[0,59]。

当RemindType（触发条件）为TIMEOUT（运行超时）时，传参格式为1800，单位为秒。即从开始运行起，运行超过30分钟触发报警
parameters.name: detail

parameters.help_en: The granularity of the alert recipient. Valid values: OWNER (node owner) and OTHER (specified user)
parameters.help_zh: 报警接收对象的粒度，包括OWNER（任务责任人）和OTHER（指定的人）
parameters.name: alert_unit

parameters.help_en:
The alert method. Valid values:
MAIL: email.
SMS: text message.
<props="intl">The regions that support SMS alerts are Singapore, Malaysia (Kuala Lumpur), and Germany (Frankfurt).</props>
<props="china">- PHONE: phone call. Only DataWorks Professional Edition and higher editions are supported.</props>
Webhooks (WeCom or Lark chatbot). This alert method takes effect only after the Webhooks parameter is configured.
DINGROBOTS: DingTalk chatbot.

Separate multiple alert methods with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh:
报警方式，取值如下：
MAIL：邮件。
SMS：短信。
<props="intl">可使用短信告警的地域为：新加坡、马来西亚（吉隆坡）、德国（法兰克福）。</props>
<props="china">- PHONE：电话。仅DataWorks专业版及以上版本支持。</props>
Webhooks（企业微信或飞书机器人），仅当配置 Webhooks 参数后，该报警方式才会生效。
DINGROBOTS：钉钉群机器人。

多个报警方式之间使用英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: alert_methods

parameters.help_en:
When AlertUnit (alert recipient) is set to OWNER (node owner), pass an empty value.

When AlertUnit (alert recipient) is set to OTHER (specified user), pass the Alibaba Cloud UIDs of the specified users. Separate multiple Alibaba Cloud UIDs with commas (,). A maximum of 10 UIDs are supported
parameters.help_zh:
当AlertUnit（报警接收人）为OWNER（节点任务责任人）时，传空。

当AlertUnit（报警接收人）为OTHER（指定的人）时，传入指定用户的阿里云UID。多个阿里云UID之间使用英文逗号（,）分隔，最多支持10个
parameters.name: alert_targets

parameters.help_en: The webhook URLs of DingTalk chatbots. Separate multiple webhook URLs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 钉钉群机器人的webhook地址，多个webhook地址之间使用英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: robot_urls

parameters.help_en:
The webhook URLs of WeCom or Lark chatbots. Separate multiple webhook URLs with commas (,). The alertMethods parameter must include the WEBHOOKS alert method.

Only DataWorks Enterprise Edition is supported.
Available regions: China (Shanghai), China (Chengdu), China (Zhangjiakou), China (Beijing), China (Hangzhou), China (Shenzhen), Hong Kong (China), Germany (Frankfurt), and Singapore
parameters.help_zh:
企业微信或飞书机器人的webhook地址，多个webhook地址之间使用英文逗号（,）分隔。alertMethods 中需要包含 WEBHOOKS 告警方式。

仅DataWorks企业版支持。
可用地域：华东2（上海）、西南1（成都）、华北3（张家口）、华北2（北京）、华东1（杭州）、华南1（深圳）、中国（香港）、欧洲中部 1（法兰克福）、亚太东南1（新加坡）
parameters.name: webhooks

Data.description_en: The ID of the custom rule returned after the custom monitoring rule is created
Data.description_zh: 创建自定义监控规则成功后，返回的自定义规则ID

RequestId.description_en: The unique ID of the request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用的唯一ID。出现错误后，您可以根据该ID排查问题

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
